name: Dr. Ali Koochi
title: Associate Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering
bio: Founder of S³ Lab. For more than fifteen years his research has followed one line: size-dependent mechanics → surface effects → electromechanical (pull-in) instability → MEMS/NEMS → nanosensors → intelligent electromechanical systems. He is the first author of the Elsevier book “Nonlinear Differential Equations in Micro/nano Mechanics” (2020).
interests: Theoretical mechanics; NEMS/MEMS; Pull-in instability; Casimir & van der Waals forces; Non-classical continuum theories; Nonlinear vibration

name: Dr. Masoud Gohari-Manesh
title: Associate Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering
bio: Co-founder of S³ Lab. He works on nonlinear, robust and intelligent control of electromechanical systems — including fuzzy control of nano-tweezers and micro-tweezer dynamics — and builds the lab's interactive simulators and digital tools.
interests: Intelligent & fuzzy control; Robust control; Micro/nano manipulation; Interactive simulation; Robotics
